### When it Comes to Radiation Protection, Quality Matters Most. AADCO Delivers.

 AADCO Medical, Inc. is a leader in the design and manufacture of Medical Imaging products for
distribution both domestically and internationally.  We present the industry’s most versatile group
of Radiation Protection Products and Solutions for Medical Imaging.

The superior quality of our radiation protection products extends from our core philosophy and
company culture. We adhere to the highest standard of quality in the medical imaging manufacturing
industry with a ISO 13485:2016 Quality System.

[More About Us][107] [Read Reviews][108]

### Flexible Ordering. Expert Assistance.

### Shop Online

Browse our products online and request a quick quote for just what you need, or request an online
account with us to place orders directly.

[Shop Online][109]

### Find a Sales Rep

Get personal assistance, expert advice and even special pricing for volume orders with one of our
sales reps located all over the country.

[Find a Rep][110]

### Browse Catalog

Flip through our full catalog of products – it’s the largest and most diverse in the industry, with
an amazing range of options for every budget.

[Our Catalog][111]

###### Made with Care in the Heart of Vermont!

Our innovative product line is manufactured right here in the USA, at our facility in Randolph
Vermont.

It includes the highly esteemed ErgoLite® radiation protection apron, proven to reduce
career-shortening stress injuries and our proprietary MRI-Safe™ Overhead Suspension Systems. 
* #### ErgoLite® X-Ray Aprons
* #### RayShield® Radiology Aprons
* #### Comfortlight® Aprons
* #### MRI-Safe™ Overhead Suspension Systems
* #### Radiology Barriers & Shields
* #### Medical Lighting Systems
* #### Surgical Radiology Protection
* #### Much More!

###### “The ErgoLight Apron Changed My Life!”

“ErgoLite® gives me good radiation protection. It helps my back and shoulders by redistributing the
weight onto my hips. It’s a great piece of equipment and I swear by it… It gives me safety, 360
degrees, it’s comfortable, and I don’t have to be concerned about my back during long cases. It’s a
winner on 3 counts.”

Dr. Douglas Coldwell, MD, PhD
Interventional Radiologist
Professor of Radiology & Radiation Oncology

[Shop ErgoLight Aprons][112] [See More Reviews][113]

From actual hospital workers that actively develop and test products, to our smaller, leaner, more
flexible staff and processes, we can deliver better products, faster and more affordably than our
large corporate competitors.

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

radiation protection suit:

  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

inquire about our customization services.

From lead shields to protective eyewear, Barrier Technologies is your one-stop-shop for all things
**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

### [Radiation Protective Eyewear][33]

Our vast catalog of leaded glasses provide the highest lead content in the industry and can be
delivered in your exact prescription. In contrast to foreign-made eyewear, our lenses don’t yellow
over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

### [X-ray Protection Accessories][34]

In addition to our **x ray** radiation protection suit options, we also carry a wide range of
protective accessories. For example, we offer lead shield protection ranging from heavy-duty mobile
lead shielding to single-use secure shields for physicians and patients.

Barrier Technologies is a global leader in the **radiation protective products** industry. We are a
company of motivated experts, engineers, and medical innovators with the common goal of
manufacturing the best radiation safety equipment in the world using the best **radiation shielding

inspiration from George Bernard Shaw, while some people see things how they are and say “Why?” We at

## BLOXR manufactures durable, lightweight, non-lead, scatter radiation protection aprons and x-ray
## protection shields.

Welcome! BLOXR Solutions is a USA manufacturer of proprietary scatter radiation protection products
(“lead” aprons and attenuating hand cream). BLOXR® products are designed to reduce exposure for
clinicians and patients through innovative applications of its patented technologies. Applicable to
users in hospitals, surgical centers, cardiac cath labs, interventional radiology, orthopedics,
radiology departments, imaging facilities, veterinary practices, dental offices or anywhere
protection is needed. [Find out more][27] about our lead-free x-ray aprons and products.

### Personalize your garments

At BLOXR Solutions, we offer a variety of ways to create a unique look or to outfit a team in a
coordinating color scheme. Options include monogramming, logo embroidery, pockets for dosimeters,
and more.

### 
### Lead equivalent protection

BLOXR® XPF® garments are independently validated 0.5 mm Pb equivalent. All BLOXR aprons, vests,
skirts, thyroid collars, and garments for scatter radiation protection feature a patented,
lightweight XPF bi-layer constructed of barium sulfate and bismuth oxide. XPF does not contain lead
or toxic heavy metals, making BLOXR protection “greener” than x-ray aprons containing lead, tungsten
and antimony.

### 
### Other protective options

In addition to traditional x-ray aprons, vests, skirts, and thyroid collars, BLOXR offers other ways
to protect against scatter radiation. Caps for brain protection, bra inserts for those concerned
about the breast area, shin guards, and arm sleeves provide additional protection for surgeons,
techs, and clinical staff. Protective [eyeglasses ][28]are also available.

### 
### Pregnancy solutions

Scatter radiation protection during pregnancy is so important. For those who already have their
protective apron, we recommend our Pregnancy Shield that can be worn over the top of, or underneath,
your existing garments. For new BLOXR garments, a removable Pregnancy Shield can be incorporated so
that it can be easily removed when no longer needed.

## BLOXR manufactures durable, lightweight, non-lead, scatter radiation protection aprons and x-ray
## protection shields.

Welcome! BLOXR Solutions is a USA manufacturer of proprietary scatter radiation protection products
(“lead” aprons and attenuating hand cream). BLOXR® products are designed to reduce exposure for
clinicians and patients through innovative applications of its patented technologies. Applicable to
users in hospitals, surgical centers, cardiac cath labs, interventional radiology, orthopedics,
radiology departments, imaging facilities, veterinary practices, dental offices or anywhere
protection is needed. [Find out more][27] about our lead-free x-ray aprons and products.

### Personalize your garments

At BLOXR Solutions, we offer a variety of ways to create a unique look or to outfit a team in a
coordinating color scheme. Options include monogramming, logo embroidery, pockets for dosimeters,
and more.

### 
### Lead equivalent protection

BLOXR® XPF® garments are independently validated 0.5 mm Pb equivalent. All BLOXR aprons, vests,
skirts, thyroid collars, and garments for scatter radiation protection feature a patented,
lightweight XPF bi-layer constructed of barium sulfate and bismuth oxide. XPF does not contain lead
or toxic heavy metals, making BLOXR protection “greener” than x-ray aprons containing lead, tungsten
and antimony.

### 
### Other protective options

In addition to traditional x-ray aprons, vests, skirts, and thyroid collars, BLOXR offers other ways
to protect against scatter radiation. Caps for brain protection, bra inserts for those concerned
about the breast area, shin guards, and arm sleeves provide additional protection for surgeons,
techs, and clinical staff. Protective [eyeglasses ][28]are also available.

[XPF Thyroid Collars and Caps][29]

[[X-ray attenuating thyroid collar and cap]][30]

[XPF Breast Protection][31]

[XPF Pregnancy Protection Options][32]

### 
### Pregnancy solutions

Scatter radiation protection during pregnancy is so important. For those who already have their
protective apron, we recommend our Pregnancy Shield that can be worn over the top of, or underneath,
your existing garments. For new BLOXR garments, a removable Pregnancy Shield can be incorporated so
that it can be easily removed when no longer needed.

# Diagnostic Imaging Physics Consulting & Radiation Safety Services

Board-certified, state-licensed medical physicists providing diagnostic imaging physics, radiation
safety, and accreditation support across Florida, Maryland, Virginia, Washington DC, California, and
Nevada.

Diagnostic Radiological Physics Services (DRPS) provides medical physics consulting and radiation
safety services for radiation-using facilities—including equipment performance evaluations,
shielding design, and accreditation support—to help you maintain safe, compliant imaging operations.

Our qualified medical physicists support ACR, IAC, RadSite, MQSA, and Joint Commission accreditation
programs, plus regulatory compliance, shielding design, and equipment performance evaluations.

We help your team stay **inspection-ready, accreditation-ready, and audit-ready**—with practical
solutions and responsive service.

[Request Services][34] [Explore Our Services][35]

## Diagnostic Medical Physics Consulting

Our board-certified diagnostic medical physicists provide CT physics testing, MRI physics testing,
nuclear medicine and PET physics, mammography MQSA support, and radiography and fluoroscopy surveys.

We deliver equipment performance evaluations and protocol optimization so your imaging systems
maintain image quality, manage dose, and meet regulatory and accreditation expectations.

### Equipment Performance Evaluations (EPEs)

Acceptance testing and periodic performance evaluations meeting ACR, MQSA, and state requirements,
with clear documentation for your records and inspectors.

### X-ray & Fluoroscopy Physics Services

Surveys and performance evaluations for general radiography and fluoroscopy systems, including
C-arms and R/F rooms, with attention to image quality, dose, and regulatory compliance.

### CT Physics Services

CT phantom testing, dose index evaluation, and performance checks to support safe operation,
protocol optimization, and CT accreditation requirements.

### MRI Physics Services

MRI system performance evaluations, phantom testing, and support for MRI safety programs, including
image quality evaluations and safety-related checks, coil performance, and consistency over time.

### Mammography Physics (MQSA) Services

Mammography physics support and performance evaluations that align with MQSA and accreditation
expectations for image quality and dose.

### Nuclear Medicine & PET Physics Services

Performance evaluations for nuclear medicine and PET systems, including camera and dose calibrator
checks, with documentation suited for accreditation and regulatory review.

[Medical physics consulting services →][36]

## Radiation Safety & Shielding

Named RSO services and radiation safety consulting for facilities with radioactive materials,
designed to support a robust, defensible radiation safety program.

We support radiation safety programs from fundamentals to advanced needs, helping facilities
maintain regulatory defensibility and consistent practices.

### Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) Services

RSO support tailored to your program, including policy and procedure development, audits, incident
review, ongoing compliance monitoring, and preparation for regulatory inspections.

[Learn more about RSO services →][37]

### Radiation Safety Consulting

Practical guidance on regulatory requirements, radiation protection practices, and program
improvements that reduce risk and support safe operations.

### Shielding Design & Radiation Protection Consulting

Expert radiation shielding design and calculations for new construction and renovations, including
documentation suitable for architectural review, regulatory approval, and post-construction
verification.

[Learn more →][38]

## Accreditation & Inspection Support

We support accreditation and readiness programs required by imaging programs and healthcare quality
organizations. [Learn more about our accreditation support services][39].
* **ACR Accreditation Support** (CT, MRI, NM, PET, Mammography)
* **IAC Support** (as applicable by modality)
* **MQSA Support**
* **Joint Commission readiness** (physics documentation and compliance support)
* Survey-ready documentation: physics reports, performance data, and QA records organized for easy
  in

## Plastics Dominate Medical-Device Redesigns to Curb Healthcare Costs

article about this topic.Over the past few years, the healthcare industry has witnessed a
significant shift in how medical devices are being designed. With the increasing pressure to reduce
costs, manufacturers are looking for new ways to optimize their products. One of the more recent
strategies is the incorporation of plastic materials in medical device redesigns.The use of plastic
materials in medical devices is not a new phenomenon. However, advances in material science and
engineering have made plastics more appealing to manufacturers. Plastics are relatively inexpensive
compared to traditional materials like metal, glass, or ceramics. They are also easy to shape,
allowing for complex geometries that would be difficult to achieve using traditional methods.
Additionally, many plastic materials offer excellent biocompatibility, making them useful for
implantable devices.While the adoption of plastic materials in medical device redesigns has many
benefits, there are also some concerns that must be addressed. One of the primary concerns is the
potential for leaching of toxic chemicals from plastics into patient tissues. Plastic materials can
break down over time and release chemicals that could be harmful to patients. Manufacturers are
addressing this issue by using materials that are less likely to degrade, or by adding barrier
layers to prevent leaching.Another issue with plastic materials is their potential for deformation
or failure under stress. Medical devices must be able to withstand rigorous use and abuse while
maintaining their functionality. Engineers are now using advanced modeling and simulation techniques
to predict how plastic materials will behave under various loading conditions. This allows
manufacturers to design medical devices that are both robust and reliable.One area where plastic
materials are being used extensively is in the production of single-use medical devices. Single-use
devices are those that are intended to be used once and then discarded. Examples of such devices
include syringes, catheters, and surgical instruments. Single-use devices made from plastic
materials are often cheaper to produce than those made from metal or other materials. They also
eliminate the need for sterilization, reducing costs and eliminating potential sources of
infection.Despite the many benefits of plastic materials in medical device redesigns, there are some
potential drawbacks to consider. Plastics can be more difficult to recycle than traditional
materials, creating waste that could have negative environmental impacts. Additionally, some
patients may be allergic to certain plastic materials, which could limit their use in certain
applications.In conclusion, the incorporation of plastic materials in medical device redesigns is a
growing trend in the healthcare industry. While there are some concerns to address, the benefits of
using plastic materials are clear. Manufacturers can produce medical devices that are both cheaper
and more effective, ensuring that patients receive the best possible care. As plastic materials
continue to advance, it is likely that we will see even more innovative uses for them in the
healthcare industry in the years to come.

article about this topic.Over the past few years, the healthcare industry has witnessed a
significant shift in how medical devices are being designed. With the increasing pressure to reduce
costs, manufacturers are looking for new ways to optimize their products. One of the more recent

materials in medical devices is not a new phenomenon. However, advances in material science and
engineering have made plastics more appealing to manufacturers. Plastics are relatively inexpensive
compared to traditional materials like metal, glass, or ceramics. They are also easy to shape,
allowing for complex geometries that would be difficult to achieve using traditional methods.
Additionally, many plastic materials offer excellent biocompatibility, making them useful for
implantable devices.While the adoption of plastic materials in medical device redesigns has many
benefits, there are also some concerns that must be addressed. One of the primary concerns is the
potential for leaching of toxic chemicals from plastics into patient tissues. Plastic materials can
break down over time and release chemicals that could be harmful to patients. Manufacturers are
addressing this issue by using materials that are less likely to degrade, or by adding barrier
layers to prevent leaching.Another issue with plastic materials is their potential for deformation
or failure under stress. Medical devices must be able to withstand rigorous use and abuse while
maintaining their functionality. Engineers are now using advanced modeling and simulation techniques
to predict how plastic materials will behave under various loading conditions. This allows
manufacturers to design medical devices that are both robust and reliable.One area where plastic
materials are being used extensively is in the production of single-use medical devices. Single-use
devices are those that are intended to be used once and then discarded. Examples of such devices
include syringes, catheters, and surgical instruments. Single-use devices made from plastic
materials are often cheaper to produce than those made from metal or other materials. They also
eliminate the need for sterilization, reducing costs and eliminating potential sources of
infection.Despite the many benefits of plastic materials in medical device redesigns, there are some
potential drawbacks to consider. Plastics can be more difficult to recycle than traditional
materials, creating waste that could have negative environmental impacts. Additionally, some
patients may be allergic to certain plastic materials, which could limit their use in certain
applications.In conclusion, the incorporation of plastic materials in medical device redesigns is a
growing trend in the healthcare industry. While there are some concerns to address, the benefits of
using plastic materials are clear. Manufacturers can produce medical devices that are both cheaper
and more effective, ensuring that patients receive the best possible care. As plastic materials
continue to advance, it is likely that we will see even more innovative uses for them in the
healthcare industry in the years to come.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about our radiation and NDT services.

What types of isotypes do you supply?

We supply a comprehensive range of radioactive isotopes for medical diagnostics, industrial
applications, and research purposes. This includes sealed sources for radiation therapy, industrial
radiography sources, calibration sources, and various isotopes for nuclear medicine. All supplies
are fully compliant with UK regulations and include complete documentation and safety certification.

Do you support industrial NDT and calibration services?

Yes, we provide complete NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) solutions including ultrasonic testing,
radiography, eddy current testing, and magnetic particle inspection. Our calibration services cover
all safety-critical equipment with UKAS-accredited procedures, ensuring your equipment meets
regulatory standards and maintains precision accuracy.

How do I book radiation detection or calibration services?

Booking our services is simple. You can contact us via phone, email, or through our online
consultation request form. Our team will assess your requirements, provide a detailed quote, and
schedule the service at your convenience. We offer flexible scheduling including emergency call-out
services for urgent requirements.

What safety and compliance standards does HTSL follow?

HTSL Group operates under strict ISO 9001 certification and adheres to all UK radiation safety
regulations including IRR17, EPR16, and relevant HSE guidelines. We are an accredited supplier with
comprehensive quality management systems, ensuring full legal compliance and safety standards
adherence for all our services and products.

What training courses do you offer?

We offer certified training courses for Radiation Protection Supervisors (RPS). Our courses are
designed to meet UK regulatory requirements and provide comprehensive training on radiation safety,
compliance, and best practices. We also offer bespoke training programs tailored to specific
organisational needs.

What areas of the UK do you cover?

We provide nationwide coverage across the entire UK, including Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland,
and England. Our extensive network ensures rapid response times and comprehensive support regardless
of your location. We can mobilize our teams quickly for emergency situations and routine services
alike.

From freshwater rivers, lakes and lagoons to coastal marine cages, trout farming is a dynamic sub
sector of aquaculture in Latin America, which supports thousands of livelihoods across the region.
But trout raised in open water farms are vulnerable to diseases that spread easily in water.

# Nuclear Radiation Safety Protection Advisor in India – Trusted by Industry Leaders and
# Institutions

INRAD is a leading **nuclear radiation safety protection advisor in India** – offering word-class
technical and analytical services trusted by industry leaders and institutions. With decades of
experience – INRAD delivers cutting-edge technology and unmatched customer service to help document
and manage **ionizing radiation exposure** in workplaces + environmental zones + healthcare
settings.

As a trusted **Radiation protection company** – INRAD leads in occupational and environmental
exposure assessment and is a premier provider of outsourced medical physics services in the United
States. Our expert **radiation protection advisors** help clients adopt best practices in **nuclear
radiation protection** and maintain full regulatory compliance.

INRAD collaborates with clients and government bodies to develop risk-reduction strategies and
influence public health and **nuclear safety** legislation. Our legacy of dosimeter archiving
supports the national radiation register. With ongoing innovations in **radiation protection
services** – INRAD is regarded as the **best radiation safety provider in India** and globally.

[About Inrad]

## Our Premium Services

[Scrap Metal Detection Services]

### Radioactive Material Transport

INRAD provides trusted solutions for the safe transportation of radioactive material across India.
We manage the procurement, packaging, licensing, and delivery of radioactive material RAM with full
regulatory compliance.

[ Read More →][25]

### Radiation Shielding

At INRAD, we design and install custom radiation shielding systems for medical + industrial +
research environments. Our experts assess your layout, radiation sources, and exposure levels to
build effective radioactive shielding plans.

[ Read More →][26]
[Radiation Protection and Safety]
[Land Remediation]

### Radiation Detection Device & Monitoring

We provide advanced radiation detection equipment and monitoring solutions for continuous safety
oversight. We supply and install certified radiation detector devices for hospitals + laboratories +
industrial facilities.

[ Read More →][27]

### Radiation Safety Training & Awareness Program

INRAD offers customized radiation awareness programs to help teams understand and manage radiation
risks effectively. Our sessions cover ionizing radiation safety + operational protocols + emergency
response.

[ Read More →][28]
[Environmental Protection]
[Borescope Inspection]

### AERB, BARC, IAEA Approved

INRAD is an AERB approved company offering end-to-end support for radioactive licensing and
regulatory approvals. We assist with applications + inspections + documentation as per national and
international safety codes.

[ Read More →][29]

### Non Destructive Testing

INRAD provides certified non-destructive testing (NDT) solutions for critical infrastructure and
manufacturing units. Our NDT inspection services include ultrasonic testing + radiography testing +
visual examinations.

[ Read More →][30]
[Non-Destructive Testing]
[Third Party Inspection]

### Radiation Area Survey

We conduct detailed radiation area surveys to assess exposure levels in medical + industrial +
research facilities. Our specialists carry out each area survey using calibrated instruments and
site-specific protocols.

[ Read More →][31]

### PMI Inspection & Testing

INRAD offers PMI testing in India to verify material composition without damaging the sample. Our
PMI inspection services support industries handling metals, alloys, and scrap.

[ Read More →][32]

[Third Party Inspection]

### Scrap Metal Detection Services

Scrap metal recycling is the process of recovering and processing scrap metal from end-of-life items
or buildings, as well as manufacturing scrap, in order to use it as a raw material in the
manufacture of new goods.

## About us

We use all kinds of rare earth non ferrous metals like INDIUM, GALLIUM, TIN, BISMUTH, LEAD, ZINC,
ALUMINIUM, COPPER etc., for manufacturing of various high performance alloys. We also specialize in
manufacturing of fusible alloys and low temperature alloys. We are one of the largest manufactures
of Indium foils in India and can also supply safety relief devices to most of the CNG kit
manufactures in India.
[VIEW MORE ][242]

### In-house Manufacturing Capabilities

Our robust manufacturing capabilities are underpinned by two facilities located in Ghaziabad, Uttar
Pradesh and Una, Himachal Pradesh.

### Customer Centric Approach

With a customer-first approach and commitment to quality, we continue to build trust and strengthen
our position as a long-term supplier of high-quality products across diverse industries.

### Dedicated Team

Collaborative, focused, skilled individuals united, achieving shared goals effectively together.

### Quality Assurance

Ensure standards, verify processes, maintain excellence, meet specifications, assure reliability.

## " A House of Non-ferrous and Low-Temperature Alloys available in all kinds of shapes and sizes "

[Get Quotations][243]

## Our Products

[ Bismuth & Tin-Based Alloys][244]
Bismuth-based alloys, featuring low toxicity and low melting points, find applications in
electronics, soldering, and as a component in medical devices.
[VIEW MORE ][245]
[ Low Temperature Alloys][246]
Low-temperature alloys exhibit enhanced properties at colder conditions, providing durability and
resilience in applications such as cryogenics, aerospace, and medical devices.
[VIEW MORE ][247]
[ Solder Preforms][248]
Tin-based alloys, like pewter or solder blends, are versatile materials widely used in electronics,
metallurgy, and traditional crafts due to their low melting points and durability.
[VIEW MORE ][249]
[ Lens Blocking Alloys][250]
Lens blocking alloys, like bismuth-based compositions, facilitate lens edging by providing a
malleable and easily removable material for ophthalmic lens production.
[VIEW MORE ][251]
[ Indium Foils][252]
Indium foils, with high malleability and excellent thermal conductivity, are used in electronics for
soldering, thermal management, and flexible displays.
[VIEW MORE ][253]
[ Weight valves][254]
Weight valves are used in pressure cookers for regulating pressure inside a cooker for cooking.
[VIEW MORE ][255]
[Radiation Shielding Products][256]
Lead bricks, dense and effective in attenuating radiation, are used for shielding in nuclear
facilities, medical environments, and industrial applications to ensure safety.
[VIEW MORE ][257]
[ White Metal (Babbit Alloy)][258]
White metal, often a Babbitt alloy, is a soft and low-friction material used for bearings, bushings,
and thrust washers in machinery and engines.
[VIEW MORE ][259]
[Vent Tubes][260]
Vent tubes are used in pressure cookers as an outlet point for steam to release into the environment
on which a weight valve is mounted.
[VIEW MORE ][261]

Jaytee Alloys & Components Limited offers different metal compositions and shapes. Please browse
through our offerings and do not hesitate to contact us if you need any assistance.

We use all kinds of rare earth non ferrous metals like INDIUM, GALLIUM, TIN, BISMUTH, LEAD, ZINC,
ALUMINIUM, COPPER etc., for manufacturing of various high performance alloys. We also specialize in
manufacturing of fusible alloys and low temperature alloys. We are one of the largest manufactures
of Indium foils in India and can also supply safety relief devices to most of the CNG kit
manufactures in India.
[VIEW MORE ][242]

### In-house Manufacturing Capabilities

Our robust manufacturing capabilities are underpinned by two facilities located in Ghaziabad, Uttar
Pradesh and Una, Himachal Pradesh.

With a customer-first approach and commitment to quality, we continue to build trust and strengthen
our position as a long-term supplier of high-quality products across diverse industries.

## Our Products

[ Bismuth & Tin-Based Alloys][244]
Bismuth-based alloys, featuring low toxicity and low melting points, find applications in
electronics, soldering, and as a component in medical devices.
[VIEW MORE ][245]
[ Low Temperature Alloys][246]
Low-temperature alloys exhibit enhanced properties at colder conditions, providing durability and
resilience in applications such as cryogenics, aerospace, and medical devices.
[VIEW MORE ][247]
[ Solder Preforms][248]
Tin-based alloys, like pewter or solder blends, are versatile materials widely used in electronics,
metallurgy, and traditional crafts due to their low melting points and durability.
[VIEW MORE ][249]
[ Lens Blocking Alloys][250]
Lens blocking alloys, like bismuth-based compositions, facilitate lens edging by providing a
malleable and easily removable material for ophthalmic lens production.
[VIEW MORE ][251]
[ Indium Foils][252]
Indium foils, with high malleability and excellent thermal conductivity, are used in electronics for
soldering, thermal management, and flexible displays.
[VIEW MORE ][253]
[ Weight valves][254]
Weight valves are used in pressure cookers for regulating pressure inside a cooker for cooking.
[VIEW MORE ][255]
[Radiation Shielding Products][256]
Lead bricks, dense and effective in attenuating radiation, are used for shielding in nuclear
facilities, medical environments, and industrial applications to ensure safety.
[VIEW MORE ][257]
[ White Metal (Babbit Alloy)][258]
White metal, often a Babbitt alloy, is a soft and low-friction material used for bearings, bushings,
and thrust washers in machinery and engines.
[VIEW MORE ][259]
[Vent Tubes][260]
Vent tubes are used in pressure cookers as an outlet point for steam to release into the environment
on which a weight valve is mounted.
[VIEW MORE ][261]

## COMMUNIQUÉ

Lemer Pax déménage dans son nouveau bâtiment phare : le Monarch
Face à la croissance soutenue de ses activités dans les domaines de la médecine nucléaire et de la
radiopharmacie, **Lemer Pax** annonce le déménagement de son siège social et de l’ensemble de ses
activités vers un site plus vaste et moderne situé **14 avenue Syrma à Carquefou** à l’est de la
métropole nantaise.

[En savoir plus][46]

## REPORTAGE

IMMERSION AU COEUR DE LA RADIOPHARMACIE DU GIP CYCERON A la pointe de la technologie, cette
radiopharmacie joue un rôle central dans la préparation des médicaments radiopharmaceutiques.
**Découvrez en images le témoignage du Dr. Ahmed ABBAS, Radiopharmacien au GIP Cyceron à Caen en
France !**

équipes de l’Hôpital d’Esbjerg, Danemark, rendez-vous sur notre retour utilisateur !

With over 100 years’ experience, we protect the experts who look after your health.

We are a leading global manufacturer and developer of radiation protection and medical suspension
systems for hospitals and medical practices.

Made in Germany – with our high-quality products, manufactured in Munich, we ensure your safety in
the medical environment.

We practise sustainability for a healthy future by taking action, not just talking about it. Since
2021, all our materials have been PFC (PFAS)-free and environmentally friendly. We operate
internationally – sourcing and manufacturing regionally.

 

**Made In Germany. Made With Quality. Made by MAVIG. **

## **Your Safety Begins with Us.**

 

With over 100 years’ experience, we protect the experts who look after your health.

We are a leading global manufacturer and developer of radiation protection and medical suspension
systems for hospitals and medical practices.

Made in Germany – with our high-quality products, manufactured in Munich, we ensure your safety in
the medical environment.

We practise sustainability for a healthy future by taking action, not just talking about it. Since
2021, all our materials have been PFC (PFAS)-free and environmentally friendly. We operate
internationally – sourcing and manufacturing regionally.

 

**Made In Germany. Made With Quality. Made by MAVIG. **

## Frequently Asked Questions

How do I find the right hospital abroad?

Use our hospital directory to browse JCI-accredited hospitals by country, specialty, or procedure.
Compare ratings, read patient reviews, and request free quotes directly from the hospital's
international patient department.

How much can I save on medical treatment abroad?

Patients typically save 40–80% compared to prices in the US, UK, or Australia. For example, a heart
bypass costing $45,000 in the US may cost $5,000–$8,000 in India or Thailand, with comparable
quality at internationally accredited hospitals.

Is the medical information on MyMedicPlus trustworthy?

Yes. All medical content is written by experienced health writers and reviewed by qualified medical
professionals. Every page shows the last updated date and the reviewing doctor's credentials. We
follow strict editorial guidelines and cite all sources.

Are the health calculators accurate?

Our health tools use validated, peer-reviewed formulas (WHO, AHA, etc.). They provide estimates for
educational purposes and are not a substitute for professional medical assessment. Always consult a
healthcare provider for personalized advice.

How do I get started with medical tourism?

Start by browsing our country guides to understand costs and visa requirements. Contact hospitals
directly through our platform for free quotes and video consultations. Our step-by-step medical
tourism planning guide walks you through every stage of the journey.

## Ready to make confident healthcare decisions?

Whether you're researching a condition, comparing treatment costs abroad, or looking for the right
hospital — MyMedicPlus is here to guide you, every step of the way.

## Revolutionizing Radiation Protection

Protect Physicians and Healthcare Staff from C-arm Scatter Radiation at the Source.

[ Explore More ][57]
[Row midpoint Shape]

### Scatter Radiation Protection at the Touch of a Button

The Radiaction Smart Shield offers a dynamic barrier of protection for the medical team. This
innovative technology transfers the shielding from the personnel to the fluoroscopy system. With
rapid 2-3 second deployment and retraction, Radiaction maintains workflow efficiency while enabling
immediate patient access.

###### [See what industry experts are saying ][58]

[Row midpoint Shape]

### C-arm Scatter Radiation May Present a Health Risk to the Medical Team

Giving patients the best care doesn’t mean continually putting yourself at risk for ionizing
radiation-based complications.

[Brain Tumor]
[Breast Cancer]
[Cataracts]
[Cognitive Degradation]
[Fetal Exposure]
[Orthopedic Injury]
[Thyroid Disease]

###### [Validated by clinical experts ][59]

[Row midpoint Shape]
[Value to Hospital Staff with Radiaction Medical Devices]

### Your Medical Teams Deserve the Best Protection Possible

Radiaction Medical has developed the first system to proactively block radiation at the source,
providing the interventional team with comprehensive scatter radiation protection.

###### [Learn more about Radiaction Smart Shield ][60]

### Maintain Full-Service Capacity and Procedural Volume

Reduce opportunity loss by adopting the most advanced radiation protection available. Radiaction
Smart Shield assists hospitals in meeting occupational safety standards for radiation exposure.

###### [Increase facility capacity and productivity ][61]

[Portrait of a happy female surgeon smiling in an operating theatre - Copyspce]

### Trusted in Clinical Settings

Dr. Ashish Bhatia | Electrophysiologist

"Prior to Radiaction, I was speaking to my facility about decreasing my procedure hours due to my
concerns with radiation exposure, now I feel great comfort having the system in my EP lab, and I
never want to perform procedures without it…the blue light indicating the system is deployed gives
me great comfort."

#### Assuta Ashdod University MC

Prof. Avishag Laish-Farkash | Head of Electrophysiology

“Protecting myself and my team from scatter radiation is a top priority. Performing long ablation
procedures and increased procedure volume exposes electrophysiologists to a high level of
accumulated radiation, which becomes a real concern.”

#### Assuta Ashdod University Medical Center

Prof. Eli Lev | Director Cardiology Department

“Our staff is exposed to a significant amount of scatter radiation, and our aim is to try and
decrease and reduce radiation as much as we can….I have to say the system is very easy to deploy and
operate. It incorporates very well with the flow of the coronary cath and EP arena. We have seen
with our experience that it reduces radiation by over 90 percent, a very significant amount of
radiation reduction.”

### Radiaction in the News

##### Workflow in the Lab]

Protect Physicians and Healthcare Staff from C-arm Scatter Radiation at the Source.

[ Explore More ][57]
[Row midpoint Shape]

### Scatter Radiation Protection at the Touch of a Button

The Radiaction Smart Shield offers a dynamic barrier of protection for the medical team. This
innovative technology transfers the shielding from the personnel to the fluoroscopy system. With
rapid 2-3 second deployment and retraction, Radiaction maintains workflow efficiency while enabling
immediate patient access.

###### [See what industry experts are saying ][58]

### C-arm Scatter Radiation May Present a Health Risk to the Medical Team

Giving patients the best care doesn’t mean continually putting yourself at risk for ionizing
radiation-based complications.

[Brain Tumor]
[Breast Cancer]
[Cataracts]
[Cognitive Degradation]

[Orthopedic Injury]
[Thyroid Disease]

###### [Validated by clinical experts ][59]

[Row midpoint Shape]
[Value to Hospital Staff with Radiaction Medical Devices]

### Your Medical Teams Deserve the Best Protection Possible

Radiaction Medical has developed the first system to proactively block radiation at the source,
providing the interventional team with comprehensive scatter radiation protection.

###### [Learn more about Radiaction Smart Shield ][60]

### Maintain Full-Service Capacity and Procedural Volume

Reduce opportunity loss by adopting the most advanced radiation protection available. Radiaction
Smart Shield assists hospitals in meeting occupational safety standards for radiation exposure.

###### [Increase facility capacity and productivity ][61]

[Portrait of a happy female surgeon smiling in an operating theatre - Copyspce]

### Trusted in Clinical Settings

Dr. Ashish Bhatia | Electrophysiologist

"Prior to Radiaction, I was speaking to my facility about decreasing my procedure hours due to my
concerns with radiation exposure, now I feel great comfort having the system in my EP lab, and I
never want to perform procedures without it…the blue light indicating the system is deployed gives
me great comfort."

#### Assuta Ashdod University MC

Prof. Avishag Laish-Farkash | Head of Electrophysiology

“Protecting myself and my team from scatter radiation is a top priority. Performing long ablation
procedures and increased procedure volume exposes electrophysiologists to a high level of
accumulated radiation, which becomes a real concern.”

#### Assuta Ashdod University Medical Center

Prof. Eli Lev | Director Cardiology Department

“Our staff is exposed to a significant amount of scatter radiation, and our aim is to try and
decrease and reduce radiation as much as we can….I have to say the system is very easy to deploy and
operate. It incorporates very well with the flow of the coronary cath and EP arena. We have seen
with our experience that it reduces radiation by over 90 percent, a very significant amount of
radiation reduction.”

## 2. Construction and Delivery

[CAD Drawings][110]

## 3. Installation Assistance

Our experts can help handle the planning and coordination of your project.
[Case Studies][111]

## Offering Complete Turnkey Radiation Shielding Services

RPP is one of the few companies offering complete turnkey radiation shielding solutions. Our
expertise enables us to design and build efficient, high-performance shielded rooms, labs, and
buildings. With extensive experience working with equipment manufacturers, we also specialize in
removing outdated radiation equipment and installing new systems.

[Learn More About Our Turnkey Solutions][112]

## About Radiation Protection Products—History and Experience

With our headquarters located in Wayzata, MN, and the manufacturing and lead mill operations in
Chapel Hill, TN, [Radiation Protection Products][113] is a family-owned business that offers decades
of expertise to meet today's shielding challenges. Many of our experts bring over 20 years of
experience in the shielding industry, which we've been a part of for over 70 years.

Through our commitment to innovation, we continuously adapt our product line to save you time and
money without compromising safety or performance. We are recognized for developing a patented lead
angle system and introducing new X-ray safety glass to the industrial radiation protection market.
Explore our [past projects][114] and shielding protection construction [partners][115] for unique
insights into our capabilities and experience.

## Offering Complete Turnkey Radiation Shielding Services

RPP is one of the few companies offering complete turnkey radiation shielding solutions. Our
expertise enables us to design and build efficient, high-performance shielded rooms, labs, and
buildings. With extensive experience working with equipment manufacturers, we also specialize in
removing outdated radiation equipment and installing new systems.

[Learn More About Our Turnkey Solutions][112]

## About Radiation Protection Products—History and Experience

With our headquarters located in Wayzata, MN, and the manufacturing and lead mill operations in
Chapel Hill, TN, [Radiation Protection Products][113] is a family-owned business that offers decades
of expertise to meet today's shielding challenges. Many of our experts bring over 20 years of
experience in the shielding industry, which we've been a part of for over 70 years.

Through our commitment to innovation, we continuously adapt our product line to save you time and
money without compromising safety or performance. We are recognized for developing a patented lead
angle system and introducing new X-ray safety glass to the industrial radiation protection market.
Explore our [past projects][114] and shielding protection construction [partners][115] for unique
insights into our capabilities and experience.

## Frequently asked questions

[Radsafe Protection Screens Illustration]

### [Where are you located?][75]

RADsafe is headquartered in Queensland, Australia. We have an international support network around
the world comprising distribution partners, third-party logistics and warehousing and international
sales representation.

### [How long do orders take to fulfil?][76]

Custom product which are manufactured to order have a 4-6 week production lead time and then
shipping time from our factory in Queensland, Australia. We have a standard range of products
warehoused across the world with distribution and logistics partners so ordering from stock is
significantly faster. Contact us for info.

### [What colours are available?][77]

Our garments come in many different colours, patterns and material types. All of our materials can
be viewed on the product pages that allow material changes, or by viewing our Fabric Selection Chart
page.

### [How do I measure myself?][78]

We have fitment kits which may be available to you through one of our distributors to assist in
obtaining your measurements to determine best fit. We also have a very comprehensive measurement
page found [here][79] that can make taking measurements and finding the right sized apron much
easier.

## Frequently asked questions

[Radsafe Protection Screens Illustration]

### [Where are you located?][75]

RADsafe is headquartered in Queensland, Australia. We have an international support network around
the world comprising distribution partners, third-party logistics and warehousing and international
sales representation.

### [How long do orders take to fulfil?][76]

Custom product which are manufactured to order have a 4-6 week production lead time and then
shipping time from our factory in Queensland, Australia. We have a standard range of products
warehoused across the world with distribution and logistics partners so ordering from stock is
significantly faster. Contact us for info.

### [What colours are available?][77]

Our garments come in many different colours, patterns and material types. All of our materials can
be viewed on the product pages that allow material changes, or by viewing our Fabric Selection Chart
page.

### [How do I measure myself?][78]

We have fitment kits which may be available to you through one of our distributors to assist in
obtaining your measurements to determine best fit. We also have a very comprehensive measurement
page found [here][79] that can make taking measurements and finding the right sized apron much
easier.

in Australia & New Zealand

Radtronics helps you detect, monitor and identify radiation using the most advanced instruments
available on the market. As the exclusive Australian agent for Rotem Industries, Mirion
Technologies, and RADeCO Inc, we provide top-tier radiation detection and monitoring equipment. Our
solutions are designed to meet the highest standards, ensuring accurate and reliable results.

[ Contact Us ][44]

## Professional Equipment and Services

We offer a quality range of equipment and systems, along with extensive application support,
maintenance, repairs and calibration services. Our experienced team is dedicated to providing
exceptional service, ensuring that all equipment is maintained to the highest standards. We can keep
a check on your instruments and ensure that they keep performing optimally and also help you if you
need routine maintenance, urgent repairs or precise calibration. With Radtronics, you can trust that
your radiation detection needs are in capable hands.

detection

and compliance in various environments.

measurement

monitoring and analysis.

identification

effective risk management.

About Us

**Radiation Protection Services, Ltd.** is now part of **West Physics**, a national company that
provides radiation physics consulting services for medical facilities and industries that utilize
x-ray producing equipment or radioactive materials.

Our Springfield field office provides services in the entire Illinois region, extending to eastern
Missouri, southeast Iowa, and western Indiana. With our central location, we provide flexible and
quick response times with personal service. Our staff are cognizant of the regulations for
compliance as required by the Illinois Emergency Management Agency, Missouri Radiation Control
Program, Iowa Department of Public Health, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission and accreditation
agencies (ACR, Joint Commission, IAC) associated with medical imaging facilities. We maintain a
client database to assure timely evaluations of imaging equipment and use of radioactive materials.


From radiographic rooms to cardiac catheterization suites, we will assist with keeping your imaging
equipment compliant with current standards.  [More…][13]


CT support includes instructions for clients on data collection prior to the initial visit.
 [More…][14]


We have consultants to assist with your nuclear medicine needs, whether it is hot lab equipment,
SPECT/CT or PET/CT.  [More…][15]


Our Consultant provides services to maintain compliance with MQSA and ACR standards. We have
experience supporting mammography departments for over 20 years.  [More…][16]


An MRI safety audit is performed upon initial consultation to establish program requirements.
 [More…][17]


Licensed to utilize radioactive materials by the Illinois Emergency Management Agency. State
licensed to calibrate radiation survey instruments & perform leakage and/or contamination tests on
sealed radioactive sources.  [More…][18]

#### About us

## Experts in Radiation Safety, Guidance and Advice

Our aim is to provide our clients with the knowledge, understanding and advice required to achieve
the highest standards of legal compliance.

[ More About us ][46]

[ [British Dental Association] ][51]
[ [The British Dental Industry Association] ][52]
[Back to Top][53]

## Why do I need a radiation expert?

UK Legislation – The Ionising Radiations Regulations 2017 (IRR17), The Ionising Radiations (Medical
Exposures) Regulations 2017 (IR(ME)R17), and The Environmental Permitting Regulations 2016 (with
2018 amendments) state that any company working with sources of ionising radiation (x-rays and
radioactive isotopes) have a legal responsibility to appoint a suitable RPA, RWA, MPE or a
combination of these.

## About Stalcraft Meta

I built Stalcraft Meta to give players a set of tools for analyzing the mechanics of the Zone. These
tools use game data and simulation models to help you understand how different equipment choices
affect your performance.

You can use the platform to compare **artifact combinations** or run **ballistics simulations**. The
goal is to provide specific numbers so you can decide which loadout works best for your current
situation.

Whether you are looking for a balance between Effective HP and healing, or want to know the exact
time-to-kill for a weapon at 50 meters, these tools provide the calculations you need.

## Why Use Stalcraft Meta?

The game changes frequently with balance patches and new items. This platform stays current by
syncing with game data, providing models that account for the specific ways items interact in-game.
* **Precision Simulations:** Our Monte Carlo TTK simulations account for real-world variables like
  hit distribution and plate absorption.
* **Advanced Optimization:** The artifact optimizer uses memetic algorithms to explore millions of
  combinations in seconds.
* **Complete Item Wiki:** Access detailed stats, barter recipes, and upgrade paths for every item in
  the game.

Survival Focus

Calculate EHP and healing to ensure you can withstand the Zone's deadliest threats.

Mobility Meta

Maximize your speed and stamina to outrun anomalies and rival factions alike.

Fast Optimization

Our engine uses smart search to check thousands of combinations in seconds.

**Precision Vision Care, Engineered for Professional and Everyday Use**

**VeritasTeq** is a specialty **Vision Care Company** focused on precision-engineered eyewear across
two business verticals: **Radiation Protection Eyewear Components** supply to OEM partners and
**Luxury Consumer Eyewear** under the **Mozzati** brand. Built on medical-device design discipline,
regulatory alignment and advanced material science, the company develops application-specific
eyewear frames alongside engineered lens solutions, working closely with global lens manufacturing
partners for execution. Its approach emphasizes performance, durability and consistency—combining
engineering rigor with refined design to deliver eyewear defined by performance, durability and a
level of finish associated with luxury craftsmanship.

**Radiation Protection — Engineering-Led OEM Solutions**

VeritasTeq’s core business is the design and development of radiation protection eyewear components
for medical applications. Operating as an OEM partner, the company engineers application-specific
frame systems and lens configurations tailored to clinical environments, rather than adapting
conventional eyewear formats. Built on medical-device design discipline, material integrity, and
compliance-driven processes, this vertical prioritizes safety, performance, and long-term
reliability in demanding use conditions.

**Mozzati — Precision-Crafted Consumer Eyewear**

Through its brand Mozzati, VeritasTeq extends this foundation into the consumer segment—offering
eyewear frames and sunglasses that combine refined design with precision components. Drawing on the
same engineering discipline used in its professional vertical, Mozzati delivers the look, feel, and
build quality associated with luxury eyewear, while remaining accessible to a broader audience.

A measured expression of luxury, precision, and enduring design. Explore the entire collection at
the [Mozzati Brand Website][15]
